reason: I fall asleep to free YouTube with a 30-minute timer every night and it works fine, and since I sleep with AirPods the smart fade isn't even the default for me. I might try the free 14 days out of curiosity, but I doubt I'd pay after.
objection: My AirPods and the YouTube timer already stop the sound when I'm out, so paying for an app that fades it a bit smarter feels like paying for something I already get free.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison showed me falling asleep clearly faster, like 10+ minutes, on the SLEEP:ON nights with my AirPods on.
